source_caption_text:
Two worlds collide for one insightful conversation. 🌎🙏🏽 Fivio Foreign sits down with award-winning gospel icon Kirk Franklin to discuss the rapper's journey to Christianity, finding purpose through faith, the influence of God on his music and more. 

Tap @xxl link in bio to watch the enlightening convo.

Kirk, who once went by Kid Fresh back in the day, raps Grandmaster Flash & The Furious Five's "The Message" to Fivio to relay how that track could've been a gospel song for its subject matter of struggle, which surprises Fivio.
